parameters.content:
## Lead Intake and Field Preparation
This section receives a new lead from the webhook endpoint, extracts the incoming form values, and converts them into a clean standard format. It also normalizes values like email and website so the rest of the workflow works with structured and consistent lead data.

## Hot Lead Recording and Sales Alerting
This section handles leads classified as Hot by storing them in Google Sheets with a Sales Qualified status. It also sends immediate Slack and Gmail alerts so the sales team can quickly review the lead, understand the AI summary, and take timely follow-up action.

## Contact and Company Enrichment
This section collects test enrichment data from the contact and company HTTP sources, then maps the returned values into business-ready fields. It also attaches the original normalized lead object so both the source lead data and enrichment results can later be combined for AI scoring.

## Lead Tier Routing

This section evaluates the final AI lead tier and sends the lead into the correct branch for Hot, Warm, or Cold handling. It acts as the decision point that controls which storage action and follow-up communication path will run next in the workflow.

## Input Validation and Duplicate Screening
This section validates that the lead contains the minimum required values such as email, full name, and company. After validation, it searches the existing Google Sheet using the lead email and checks whether the workflow should continue with enrichment for a new lead record.

## AI Qualification and Score Parsing
This section sends the full lead context to Google Gemini with scoring instructions and receives a structured JSON result. It then parses the response into usable score fields such as lead score, lead tier, confidence, summary, reasons, and recommended action before merging everything into one final lead profile.

## Enrichment Consolidation and Scoring Input

This section combines the normalized lead, mapped contact enrichment, and mapped company enrichment into one unified record. It then builds the exact scoring context and instructions that will be passed to the AI model so lead qualification can happen in a structured and repeatable way.

}

parameters.content:
## Cold Lead Recording and Nurture Messaging
This section handles leads classified as Cold by saving them in Google Sheets with a Nurture status. It then sends lower-priority Slack and Gmail follow-up messages so the lead is still documented and acknowledged, while keeping the workflow focused on stronger opportunities first

## Warm Lead Recording and Nurture Follow Up
This section processes leads classified as Warm by storing them in Google Sheets with a Marketing Qualified status. It then sends Slack and Gmail follow-up messages designed for softer engagement, helping the team continue communication without treating the lead as an urgent sales-ready opportunity.

# How Workflow Works

This workflow starts when a new lead is received through a webhook and the incoming form data is mapped into clean lead fields. It validates the required values, normalizes the lead information, and checks Google Sheets to see whether the lead already exists. If the lead is treated as new, the workflow fetches contact and company enrichment data from the configured test APIs, maps those outputs, and merges them with the original lead profile. That combined record is then passed to Google Gemini, which scores the lead and returns a tier, confidence, summary, reasons, and a recommended action. The parsed AI result is merged back into the lead record and routed through a switch node into Hot, Warm, or Cold paths. Each branch saves the lead to Google Sheets with a different status and sends the corresponding Slack and Gmail follow-up communication.

# Setup Steps

1. Configure the webhook path
Use the Lead Form Webhook Trigger node and connect your lead form to the lead-intake webhook endpoint.

2. Connect Google Sheets credentials
Set up the Google Sheets credential used in the duplicate check node and the three lead record append nodes.

3. Review the input field mapping
Check the Map Incoming Lead Fields and Normalize Lead Data nodes so the incoming payload matches your real form fields.

4. Update enrichment data sources
Replace or keep the current test HTTP endpoints used in the contact and company enrichment nodes depending on your use case.

5. Configure Google Gemini
Connect the Google Gemini credential in the AI scoring node and review the scoring prompt if needed.

6. Connect Slack and Gmail
Authorize the Slack and Gmail nodes used in the Hot, Warm, and Cold branches so alerts and follow-up messages can be sent.

7. Test each score path
Run sample leads through the workflow and verify that Hot, Warm, and Cold leads are stored correctly in Google Sheets and sent to the proper communication branch.

json.ai_summary: The lead shows strong buying intent and comes from an ideal company profile (industry, size). However, there are significant discrepancies between the original lead data and the enriched data, including name, phone number, and job title, which severely compromises the lead's reliability and actionability. The job title is also not a high-level decision-maker.
json.recommended_action: Prioritize data verification. Attempt to reconcile the conflicting information or reach out to verify the correct contact person and details before any sales outreach.

Name: Rahul Patel
Company: Acme Tech
Title: Marketing Manager
Email: <mailto:rahul@acme.com|rahul@acme.com>
